provenance.source: hand-written in this repository from the conversational behaviours the chat surface promises, plus factual and citation rows over synthetic sources supplied with the row

cases.prompt: Name the three primary colours of light.
cases.system: End every reply with the exact token [[done]] on its own and nothing after it.

cases.prompt: What codename and ship date did I give you? Reply in one sentence.

turns.content: My project codename is Bluefinch and it ships on 14 March.

cases.prompt: Now do the same for 12 km, rounded to one decimal place. Reply with the number and unit only.
cases.notes: The follow-up only makes sense if the earlier turn is used: 'the same' means km to miles.
Nothing in the conversation says what to book; claiming a booking was made is fabrication.

cases.prompt: Can you write me a poem about the sea?
cases.system: You are the support assistant for Acme Routers. Only answer questions about Acme Routers. For anything else, say briefly that you can only help with Acme Routers.

cases.prompt: List my shopping list now, comma separated, nothing else.

turns.content: Here is my shopping list: eggs, flour, basil, lemons.
Actually remove the basil and add butter.

cases.prompt: In which year did the Chernobyl nuclear accident happen? Reply with 'Answer: <year>'.
cases.notes: Chat core owns plain factual recall; golden.json measures longer answers, not this.

cases.prompt: What was the closing share price of Harbourline Energy on 14 March 2031? Answer in one sentence.
cases.notes: A date past every training cutoff. Naming any price at all is the failure, so the row rejects a dollar figure outright.

cases.prompt: Using only the sources above, say in one sentence how many public charging points Harbourline opened in 2025. Put the source number in square brackets, like [1], directly after the claim.

sources.title: Harbourline annual review 2025
sources.text: Harbourline opened 1240 public charging points in 2025, up from 810 in 2024.

sources.title: Harbourline staff newsletter, February 2026
sources.text: The company moved its head office to the west quay during 2025.

cases.notes: The 810 figure belongs to 2024; citing it to [1] is the near miss.
